id-20260908-news-3.title: Merah Putih Village Cooperative Begins Distributing Social Assistance in September 2026, Thousands of Units Become New Channels for State Aid

segments.src: Pemerintah mulai menjalankan babak baru dalam distribusi bantuan sosial (bansos) dengan melibatkan Koperasi Desa dan Kelurahan Merah Putih sebagai kanal penyaluran resmi.
segments.tr: The government is starting a new chapter in the distribution of social assistance (bansos) by involving the Merah Putih Village and Sub-district Cooperatives as official distribution channels.

segments.src: Mulai September 2026, puluhan ribu unit koperasi yang tersebar di berbagai desa dan kelurahan di seluruh Indonesia diproyeksikan mulai aktif menyalurkan berbagai bentuk bantuan negara kepada masyarakat, menandai pergeseran pola distribusi yang selama ini banyak mengandalkan kantor pos, agen penyalur, maupun perbankan.
segments.tr: Starting September 2026, tens of thousands of cooperative units spread across various villages and sub-districts throughout Indonesia are projected to actively begin distributing various forms of state aid to the community, marking a shift in the distribution pattern that has so far relied heavily on post offices, distribution agents, and banking institutions.

segments.src: ## Koperasi Desa Sebagai Simpul Baru Bantuan Negara
segments.tr: ## Village Cooperatives as New Nodes for State Aid

segments.src: Program Koperasi Desa/Kelurahan Merah Putih sendiri merupakan bagian dari upaya pemerintah memperkuat ekonomi berbasis komunitas di tingkat akar rumput.
segments.tr: The Merah Putih Village/Sub-district Cooperative program itself is part of the government's effort to strengthen community-based economies at the grassroots level.

segments.src: Dengan menjadikan koperasi sebagai simpul penyaluran bansos, pemerintah berharap proses distribusi dapat berlangsung lebih dekat dengan penerima manfaat, mengingat koperasi ini dibentuk dan beroperasi langsung di wilayah desa maupun kelurahan setempat.
segments.tr: By making cooperatives the nodes for social assistance distribution, the government hopes the distribution process can take place closer to the beneficiaries, considering these cooperatives are formed and operate directly within the local village or sub-district areas.

segments.src: Skema ini juga digadang-gadang dapat mempercepat proses verifikasi data penerima, karena pengurus koperasi umumnya memiliki pemahaman yang lebih baik mengenai kondisi warga di wilayahnya masing-masing dibandingkan lembaga penyalur yang berbasis di luar daerah.
segments.tr: This scheme is also touted to accelerate the verification process of beneficiary data, because cooperative administrators generally have a better understanding of the conditions of residents in their respective regions compared to distribution institutions based outside the area.

segments.src: ## Fungsi Ganda: Kanal Bansos Sekaligus Offtaker Produk Warga
segments.tr: ## Dual Function: Social Assistance Channel and Offtaker of Residents' Products

segments.src: Selain berfungsi sebagai kanal penyaluran bansos, koperasi desa ini juga diarahkan untuk berperan sebagai offtaker atau penyerap produk hasil usaha warga setempat, mulai dari hasil pertanian, perikanan, hingga produk usaha mikro kecil dan menengah (UMKM).
segments.tr: Aside from functioning as a social assistance distribution channel, these village cooperatives are also directed to play a role as an offtaker or absorber of products from local residents' businesses, ranging from agricultural and fishery products to micro, small, and medium enterprise (MSME) products.

segments.src: Dengan peran ganda tersebut, koperasi diharapkan tidak hanya menjadi perantara bantuan, tetapi juga turut menggerakkan roda ekonomi lokal secara berkelanjutan.
segments.tr: With this dual role, cooperatives are expected not only to become intermediaries for aid, but also to help drive the local economy sustainably.

segments.src: Pola ini sejalan dengan semangat awal pembentukan koperasi desa, yakni menciptakan ekosistem ekonomi yang saling menguatkan antara program bantuan sosial dan pemberdayaan ekonomi masyarakat, bukan sekadar menjadikan warga sebagai penerima pasif bantuan negara.
segments.tr: This pattern is in line with the initial spirit of forming village cooperatives, which is to create a mutually reinforcing economic ecosystem between social assistance programs and community economic empowerment, rather than merely making residents passive recipients of state aid.

segments.src: ## Skala dan Cakupan Program
segments.tr: ## Scale and Scope of the Program

segments.src: Berdasarkan informasi yang beredar, jumlah koperasi desa dan kelurahan yang telah terbentuk mencapai puluhan ribu unit di berbagai provinsi.
segments.tr: Based on circulating information, the number of village and sub-district cooperatives that have been formed reaches tens of thousands of units across various provinces.

segments.src: Skala ini menjadikan program penyaluran bansos melalui koperasi sebagai salah satu inisiatif distribusi bantuan dengan jaringan terluas yang pernah dijalankan di tingkat desa.
segments.tr: This scale makes the social assistance distribution program through cooperatives one of the aid distribution initiatives with the widest network ever implemented at the village level.

segments.src: Meski demikian, kalangan pengamat kebijakan publik mengingatkan bahwa keberhasilan program ini akan sangat bergantung pada kesiapan tata kelola di masing-masing koperasi, termasuk aspek transparansi pencatatan, akuntabilitas pengurus, serta pengawasan berkelanjutan agar bantuan benar-benar sampai kepada pihak yang berhak menerimanya.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, public policy observers remind that the success of this program will heavily depend on governance readiness in each cooperative, including aspects of recording transparency, administrator accountability, and continuous supervision to ensure the aid truly reaches those entitled to receive it.

segments.src: ## Tantangan yang Perlu Diantisipasi
segments.tr: ## Challenges to Anticipate

segments.src: Sejumlah tantangan operasional turut disorot menjelang pelaksanaan program ini, di antaranya:
segments.tr: A number of operational challenges are also highlighted ahead of the implementation of this program, among them:

segments.src: - **Kesiapan sumber daya manusia** di tingkat koperasi desa yang baru terbentuk, terutama dalam hal pengelolaan data penerima bansos.
segments.tr: - **Human resource readiness** at the newly formed village cooperative level, especially regarding social assistance beneficiary data management.

segments.src: - **Infrastruktur digital dan logistik** di wilayah dengan akses terbatas, yang berpotensi memengaruhi ketepatan waktu penyaluran.
segments.tr: - **Digital and logistics infrastructure** in regions with limited access, which has the potential to affect the timeliness of distribution.

segments.src: - **Mekanisme pengawasan** untuk memastikan penyaluran berjalan tepat sasaran dan bebas dari potensi penyimpangan.
segments.tr: - **Supervision mechanisms** to ensure the distribution runs on target and is free from potential deviations.

segments.src: - **Sinkronisasi data** antara basis data penerima bansos nasional dengan data keanggotaan maupun cakupan wilayah kerja masing-masing koperasi.
segments.tr: - **Data synchronization** between the national social assistance beneficiary database and the membership data or working area scope of each cooperative.

segments.src: Pemerintah disebut tengah menyiapkan panduan teknis serta pendampingan bagi pengurus koperasi agar proses transisi kanal penyaluran ini dapat berjalan lebih terarah, termasuk melalui pelatihan dan pengawasan berjenjang dari tingkat kabupaten/kota hingga provinsi.
segments.tr: The government is reportedly preparing technical guidelines and assistance for cooperative administrators so that the transition process of this distribution channel can run more directedly, including through training and tiered supervision from the regency/city level to the province.

segments.src: ## Harapan ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Future Expectations

segments.src: Jika berjalan sesuai rencana, keberadaan koperasi desa sebagai kanal bansos berpotensi memperpendek rantai birokrasi distribusi bantuan sekaligus memberi dampak ganda bagi perekonomian desa.
segments.tr: If it goes according to plan, the existence of village cooperatives as social assistance channels has the potential to shorten the bureaucracy chain of aid distribution while giving a dual impact on the village economy.

segments.src: Di satu sisi, warga penerima manfaat mendapatkan kemudahan akses bantuan; di sisi lain, koperasi turut terdorong untuk berkembang sebagai lembaga ekonomi yang mandiri melalui perannya menyerap produk lokal.
segments.tr: On one hand, beneficiary residents get easier access to aid; on the other hand, cooperatives are encouraged to develop as independent economic institutions through their role in absorbing local products.

segments.src: Ke depan, publik akan mencermati bagaimana implementasi program ini berjalan di lapangan, khususnya menyangkut ketepatan sasaran penerima, kelancaran arus bantuan, serta konsistensi peran koperasi dalam mendukung ekonomi warga desa secara jangka panjang.
segments.tr: Going forward, the public will observe how the implementation of this program runs in the field, particularly concerning the accuracy of targets for recipients, the smooth flow of aid, and the consistency of the cooperative's role in supporting the economy of village residents in the long term.

id-20260908-news-1.title: 2027 Minimum Wage Debate Begins, Workers Propose 8.5 Percent Increase, Employers Highlight Inter-Regional Disparities

segments.src: Pembahasan mengenai kebijakan pengupahan untuk tahun 2027 mulai menghangat di tingkat nasional.
segments.tr: Discussions regarding wage policy for 2027 are starting to heat up at the national level.

segments.src: Kalangan serikat pekerja dan asosiasi pengusaha sama-sama menyuarakan pandangan mereka, meski keduanya sepakat bahwa keputusan akhir perlu bersandar pada data resmi yang lebih menyeluruh.
segments.tr: Labor unions and employer associations are both voicing their views, although both agree that the final decision should rely on more comprehensive official data.

segments.src: ## Usulan Kenaikan dari Kalangan Buruh
segments.tr: ## Proposed Increase from Labor Groups

segments.src: Konfederasi Serikat Pekerja Indonesia (KSPI) menyampaikan usulan awal agar upah minimum tahun 2027 dinaikkan pada kisaran 7,5 hingga 8,5 persen.
segments.tr: The Confederation of Indonesian Trade Unions (KSPI) submitted an initial proposal that the 2027 minimum wage be increased in the range of 7.5 to 8.5 percent.

segments.src: Usulan ini didasarkan pada pertimbangan kebutuhan hidup layak pekerja di tengah dinamika harga kebutuhan pokok, serta harapan agar daya beli buruh tidak tergerus oleh kenaikan biaya hidup.
segments.tr: This proposal is based on considerations of workers' decent living needs amid the dynamics of basic commodity prices, as well as the hope that workers' purchasing power is not eroded by the rising cost of living.

segments.src: Meski demikian, pihak serikat pekerja menegaskan bahwa angka tersebut masih bersifat usulan awal dan akan terus disesuaikan seiring keluarnya data resmi dari Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS), khususnya terkait laju inflasi dan pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, the labor union emphasized that this figure is still an initial proposal and will continue to be adjusted as official data from the Central Statistics Agency (BPS) is released, particularly regarding the inflation rate and national economic growth.

segments.src: Kedua indikator ini merupakan variabel utama yang selama ini menjadi acuan dalam formula perhitungan upah minimum.
segments.tr: These two indicators are the main variables that have been the reference in the minimum wage calculation formula.

segments.src: ## Sorotan Pengusaha soal Kesenjangan Antardaerah
segments.tr: ## Employers' Highlight on Inter-Regional Disparities

segments.src: Di sisi lain, Asosiasi Pengusaha Indonesia (Apindo) mengingatkan bahwa persoalan upah minimum tidak bisa dilihat hanya dari angka persentase kenaikan semata.
segments.tr: On the other hand, the Indonesian Employers Association (Apindo) reminded that the minimum wage issue cannot be viewed solely from the percentage figure of the increase.

segments.src: Apindo menyoroti lebarnya kesenjangan Upah Minimum Provinsi (UMP) antarwilayah di Indonesia, yang menurut mereka berpotensi menimbulkan ketimpangan baru, baik dari sisi arus investasi maupun penyerapan tenaga kerja.
segments.tr: Apindo highlighted the wide gap in the Provincial Minimum Wage (UMP) between regions in Indonesia, which they believe has the potential to cause new inequality, both in terms of investment flows and labor absorption.

segments.src: Menurut kalangan pengusaha, daerah dengan UMP yang jauh lebih tinggi dibandingkan wilayah sekitarnya berisiko kehilangan daya saing dalam menarik investasi padat karya, sementara daerah dengan upah minimum rendah rentan mengalami migrasi tenaga kerja ke wilayah lain.
segments.tr: According to employers, regions with a UMP much higher than surrounding areas risk losing competitiveness in attracting labor-intensive investments, while regions with low minimum wages are vulnerable to labor migration to other areas.

segments.src: Kondisi ini, jika tidak dikelola dengan hati-hati, dikhawatirkan dapat memperlebar kesenjangan pembangunan ekonomi antarprovinsi maupun antarkabupaten/kota.
segments.tr: This condition, if not managed carefully, is feared to widen the gap in economic development between provinces and between regencies/cities.

segments.src: ## Menanti Data Resmi Sebagai Acuan Bersama
segments.tr: ## Awaiting Official Data as a Shared Reference

segments.src: Baik serikat pekerja maupun pengusaha tampak sepakat pada satu titik: keputusan kenaikan upah minimum 2027 sebaiknya menunggu rilis data resmi BPS mengenai inflasi dan pertumbuhan ekonomi terkini.
segments.tr: Both labor unions and employers seem to agree on one point: the decision on the 2027 minimum wage increase should wait for the release of official BPS data regarding current inflation and economic growth.

segments.src: Data ini biasanya menjadi rujukan utama pemerintah, dalam hal ini Kementerian Ketenagakerjaan, saat merumuskan formula penyesuaian upah minimum setiap tahunnya.
segments.tr: This data usually serves as the main reference for the government, in this case the Ministry of Manpower, when formulating the minimum wage adjustment formula each year.

segments.src: Proses ini umumnya melibatkan pembahasan di forum Dewan Pengupahan yang beranggotakan unsur pemerintah, serikat pekerja, dan asosiasi pengusaha, guna mencari titik temu antara kebutuhan hidup layak pekerja dan keberlangsungan usaha, khususnya bagi sektor usaha kecil dan menengah yang lebih sensitif terhadap kenaikan biaya tenaga kerja.
segments.tr: This process generally involves discussions in the Wage Council forum consisting of government elements, labor unions, and employer associations, in order to find common ground between workers' decent living needs and business continuity, especially for small and medium-sized business sectors that are more sensitive to rising labor costs.

segments.src: ## Dinamika yang Perlu Dicermati
segments.tr: ## Dynamics to Observe

segments.src: Perdebatan upah minimum setiap tahun memang kerap diwarnai perbedaan pandangan antara kepentingan menjaga daya beli pekerja dan kepentingan menjaga iklim usaha tetap kompetitif.
segments.tr: The annual minimum wage debate is indeed often colored by differing views between the interests of maintaining workers' purchasing power and the interests of keeping the business climate competitive.

segments.src: Tahun ini, isu kesenjangan UMP antardaerah turut menjadi perhatian tambahan yang bisa memengaruhi arah kebijakan pengupahan ke depan.
segments.tr: This year, the issue of inter-regional UMP disparities has also become an additional concern that could influence the direction of future wage policy.

segments.src: Publik, pelaku usaha, maupun pekerja disarankan untuk terus memantau perkembangan resmi dari pemerintah dan lembaga terkait, mengingat angka final kenaikan upah minimum 2027 baru akan ditetapkan setelah melalui rangkaian pembahasan dan mempertimbangkan data ekonomi terbaru yang akan dirilis oleh BPS.
segments.tr: The public, business actors, and workers are advised to continue monitoring official developments from the government and related institutions, considering that the final figure for the 2027 minimum wage increase will only be determined after going through a series of discussions and considering the latest economic data to be released by BPS.

id-20260908-intro-marketing-5.title: [Marketing #5] Why Can One Minimarket Shelf Hold 12 Soap Brands? This Is the Logic of Segmentation

segments.src: > Produk yang dibuat "untuk semua orang" biasanya berakhir jadi produk yang tidak istimewa bagi siapa pun. Segmentasi pasar adalah cara membelah pasar yang besar dan campur aduk menjadi kelompok-kelompok kecil yang isinya orang dengan kebutuhan mirip.
segments.tr: > Products made "for everyone" usually end up being products that are not special to anyone. Market segmentation is a way of splitting a large, mixed market into small groups containing people with similar needs.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Concept of the Day

segments.src: Coba berdiri sebentar di depan rak sabun mandi di Indomaret atau Alfamart terdekat.
segments.tr: Try standing for a moment in front of the soap shelf at your nearest convenience store.

segments.src: Di satu rak yang sama Anda akan menemukan sabun batang murah, sabun cair antibakteri "untuk keluarga", sabun bayi, sabun kesehatan kulit, sampai sabun wangi mewah dengan botol pump.
segments.tr: On the same shelf, you will find cheap bar soap, antibacterial liquid soap "for the family," baby soap, skin health soap, and even luxurious scented soap with a pump bottle.

segments.src: Banyak di antaranya diproduksi oleh perusahaan yang sama.
segments.tr: Many of them are produced by the same company.

segments.src: Kalau produknya sama-sama membersihkan badan, kenapa repot-repot bikin belasan versi?
segments.tr: If the products all clean the body, why bother making a dozen versions?

segments.src: Jawabannya: **pasar bukan satu blok yang seragam.** Orang yang membeli sabun punya kebutuhan, anggaran, dan alasan yang berbeda-beda.
segments.tr: The answer: **the market is not a uniform block.** People who buy soap have different needs, budgets, and reasons.

segments.src: Ibu dengan bayi 6 bulan mencari yang aman untuk kulit sensitif.
segments.tr: A mother with a 6-month-old baby looks for something safe for sensitive skin.

segments.src: Anak kos mencari yang paling murah per mililiter.
segments.tr: A college student looks for the cheapest one per milliliter.

segments.src: Karyawan yang naik ojol tiap hari mencari yang wanginya tahan lama sampai sore.
segments.tr: An employee who takes an ojol (ride-hailing motorcycle) every day looks for one whose scent lasts until the afternoon.

segments.src: **Segmentasi pasar (segmentation)** adalah proses membagi pasar yang beragam (heterogen) menjadi beberapa kelompok yang di dalamnya relatif seragam (homogen), sehingga tiap kelompok bisa dilayani dengan penawaran yang lebih tepat.
segments.tr: **Market segmentation** is the process of dividing a diverse (heterogeneous) market into several groups that are relatively uniform (homogeneous) within themselves, so that each group can be served with more precise offerings.

segments.src: Ini adalah huruf **S** dari kerangka klasik **STP**: Segmentation → Targeting → Positioning.
segments.tr: This is the **S** letter of the classic **STP** framework: Segmentation → Targeting → Positioning.

segments.src: Segmentasi hanya membelah petanya; memilih mau melayani kelompok yang mana (targeting) dan bagaimana ingin dikenang (positioning) adalah langkah berikutnya.
segments.tr: Segmentation only splits the map; choosing which group to serve (targeting) and how you want to be remembered (positioning) are the next steps.

segments.src: Lalu, membelahnya pakai pisau apa?
segments.tr: Then, what knife do you use to split it?

segments.src: Umumnya dipakai empat kelompok variabel.
segments.tr: Generally, four variable groups are used.

segments.src: Geografis — di mana mereka tinggal**
segments.tr: Geographic — where they live**

segments.src: Pulau, provinsi, kota besar vs kabupaten, iklim, kepadatan penduduk.
segments.tr: Island, province, big city vs. regency, climate, population density.

segments.src: Produsen mi instan dan bumbu kemasan sangat sadar hal ini: selera pedas dan manis di Jawa Tengah, Jawa Barat, dan Sumatera Barat tidak sama, dan varian rasa daerah dibuat justru karena itu.
segments.tr: Instant noodle and packaged seasoning producers are very aware of this: spicy and sweet tastes in Central Java, West Java, and West Sumatra are not the same, and regional flavor variants are created precisely because of that.

segments.src: Demografis — siapa mereka di atas kertas**
segments.tr: Demographic — who they are on paper**

segments.src: Usia, jenis kelamin, pendapatan, pekerjaan, pendidikan, ukuran keluarga, tahap siklus hidup keluarga, suku, agama.
segments.tr: Age, gender, income, occupation, education, family size, family life cycle stage, ethnicity, religion.

segments.src: Ini variabel yang paling sering dipakai karena paling mudah diukur dan datanya relatif tersedia (sensus, data BPS, data pelanggan sendiri).
segments.tr: This is the variable most often used because it is the easiest to measure and the data is relatively available (census, BPS data, own customer data).

segments.src: Kelemahannya: dua orang dengan profil di atas kertas yang identik bisa berperilaku sangat berbeda.
segments.tr: The weakness: two people with identical profiles on paper can behave very differently.

segments.src: Psikografis — bagaimana cara mereka hidup dan berpikir**
segments.tr: Psychographic — how they live and think**

segments.src: Gaya hidup, nilai yang dipegang, kepribadian.
segments.tr: Lifestyle, held values, personality.

segments.src: Sering dirangkum sebagai **AIO**: *activities* (kegiatan), *interests* (minat), *opinions* (pendapat).
segments.tr: Often summarized as **AIO**: *activities*, *interests*, *opinions*.

segments.src: Dua karyawan sama-sama berusia 27 tahun dengan gaji Rp7 juta bisa berbeda total: yang satu memprioritaskan menabung untuk DP rumah dan makan siang bawa bekal, yang satu lagi rutin mencoba kafe baru dan konser.
segments.tr: Two employees both aged 27 with a salary of Rp7 million can be totally different: one prioritizes saving for a house down payment and bringing lunch, the other regularly tries new cafes and concerts.

segments.src: Demografinya kembar, psikografinya jauh.
segments.tr: The demographics are twins, the psychographics are far apart.

segments.src: Perilaku — apa yang benar-benar mereka lakukan**
segments.tr: Behavioral — what they actually do**

segments.src: Ini sering yang paling berguna, karena berbasis tindakan nyata, bukan asumsi:
segments.tr: This is often the most useful, because it is based on real actions, not assumptions:

segments.src: - **Kesempatan pembelian (occasion):** belanja besar menjelang Lebaran, THR, atau awal tahun ajaran sekolah.
segments.tr: - **Purchase occasion:** big shopping before Eid, annual bonuses (THR), or the start of the school year.

segments.src: - **Manfaat yang dicari (benefit sought):** ada yang beli pasta gigi demi napas segar, ada yang demi gigi sensitif, ada yang demi anak mau sikat gigi.
segments.tr: - **Benefit sought:** some buy toothpaste for fresh breath, some for sensitive teeth, some so their child will want to brush their teeth.

segments.src: - **Status dan tingkat pemakaian:** pengguna berat (*heavy user*) vs pengguna sesekali. Pada banyak bisnis, sebagian kecil pelanggan menyumbang porsi penjualan yang jauh lebih besar dari jumlah kepalanya.
segments.tr: - **Status and usage rate:** heavy users vs. occasional users. In many businesses, a small portion of customers contributes a much larger portion of sales than their head count.

segments.src: - **Loyalitas:** pelanggan setia, pelanggan yang berpindah-pindah, dan pemburu diskon yang hanya muncul saat tanggal kembar 9.9 atau 12.12.
segments.tr: - **Loyalty:** loyal customers, switchers, and discount hunters who only appear on double dates like 9.9 or 12.12.

segments.src: **Tidak semua pembelahan berguna.** Segmen yang layak dikejar biasanya diuji dengan lima syarat: **terukur** (ukurannya bisa diperkirakan), **cukup besar** (nilainya sepadan dengan usaha), **dapat dijangkau** (ada cara realistis menyapa mereka lewat saluran distribusi dan media), **dapat dibedakan** (segmen ini bereaksi berbeda terhadap penawaran dibanding segmen lain), dan **dapat ditindaklanjuti** (perusahaan mampu benar-benar melayaninya dengan sumber daya yang ada).
segments.tr: **Not all splitting is useful.** A segment worth pursuing is usually tested with five criteria: **measurable** (its size can be estimated), **substantial** (the value is worth the effort), **accessible** (there is a realistic way to reach them through distribution channels and media), **differentiable** (this segment reacts differently to offers compared to other segments), and **actionable** (the company is able to actually serve them with existing resources).

segments.src: Membagi pasar menjadi "orang yang suka warna biru" mungkin terukur, tapi kalau perilaku belanjanya sama saja, pembelahan itu tidak ada gunanya.
segments.tr: Dividing the market into "people who like the color blue" might be measurable, but if their shopping behavior is the same, that split is useless.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bu Rina membuka kedai kopi susu kecil di dekat kampus di Bandung.
segments.tr: Mrs. Rina opens a small milk coffee shop near a campus in Bandung.

segments.src: Modalnya terbatas, mejanya delapan.
segments.tr: Her capital is limited, she has eight tables.

segments.src: Awalnya menunya panjang sekali: kopi susu, teh manis, jus, mi rebus, nasi goreng — "biar semua orang bisa masuk".
segments.tr: Initially, the menu was very long: milk coffee, sweet tea, juice, boiled noodles, fried rice — "so everyone can come in".

segments.src: Hasilnya justru repot: bahan baku menumpuk, dapur lambat, dan tidak ada satu pun menu yang jadi alasan orang datang.
segments.tr: The result was actually a hassle: raw materials piled up, the kitchen was slow, and there wasn't a single menu item that was the reason people came.

segments.src: Ia lalu mencoba membelah pelanggannya:
segments.tr: She then tried splitting her customers:

segments.src: - **Geografis:** semua dalam radius jalan kaki 10 menit dari gerbang kampus.
segments.tr: - **Geographic:** all within a 10-minute walking radius of the campus gate.

segments.src: - **Demografis:** mahasiswa 18–23 tahun, uang jajan harian terbatas — nyaman di harga Rp15.000–20.000, mulai berpikir dua kali di atas Rp30.000.
segments.tr: - **Demographic:** students 18–23 years old, limited daily pocket money — comfortable at the Rp15,000–20,000 price point, starting to think twice above Rp30,000.

segments.src: - **Psikografis:** butuh tempat "nugas" berjam-jam; colokan listrik dan Wi-Fi lebih penting daripada interior mewah.
segments.tr: - **Psychographic:** need a place to "do assignments" for hours; power outlets and Wi-Fi are more important than luxurious interiors.

segments.src: - **Perilaku:** ramai pada siang sampai sore hari kerja, memuncak saat musim UTS/UAS, dan hampir kosong pada akhir pekan panjang saat mahasiswa pulang kampung.
segments.tr: - **Behavioral:** busy from noon to late afternoon on weekdays, peaking during midterms/finals season, and almost empty on long weekends when students go home.

segments.src: Di sebelahnya, ada segmen lain yang juga lewat: karyawan kantor sekitar yang membeli kopi jam 8 pagi, tidak duduk, dan tidak keberatan membayar Rp28.000 asal cepat.
segments.tr: Next to it, there is another segment that also passes by: office employees nearby who buy coffee at 8 AM, don't sit down, and don't mind paying Rp28,000 as long as it's fast.

segments.src: Dua kelompok ini butuh hal yang berbeda.
segments.tr: These two groups need different things.

segments.src: Bu Rina akhirnya memangkas menu jadi tujuh item, menambah colokan di setiap meja, membuat paket "nugas" kopi refill sore hari, sekaligus menyiapkan antrean *take away* cepat untuk pagi hari.
segments.tr: Mrs. Rina finally trimmed the menu to seven items, added outlets to every table, created a "study" package with afternoon coffee refills, while also preparing a fast take-away queue for the morning.

segments.src: Angka-angka di atas tentu ilustrasi, tapi polanya nyata: begitu ia berhenti melayani "semua orang" dan mulai melihat kelompok, keputusan soal menu, harga, jam buka, dan tata ruang jadi jauh lebih mudah — karena setiap keputusan punya alamat yang jelas.
segments.tr: The numbers above are certainly illustrations, but the pattern is real: once she stopped serving "everyone" and started looking at groups, decisions about the menu, price, opening hours, and layout became much easier — because every decision has a clear address.

segments.src: Perhatikan juga apa yang **tidak** dilakukan Bu Rina: ia tidak membuat segmen "pecinta kopi sejati".
segments.tr: Also notice what Mrs. Rina did **not** do: she did not create a "true coffee lover" segment.

segments.src: Kedengarannya keren, tapi tidak terukur, tidak bisa dijangkau lewat saluran tertentu, dan tidak memberi tahu ia harus buka jam berapa.
segments.tr: It sounds cool, but it's not measurable, cannot be reached through specific channels, and doesn't tell her what time she should open.

segments.src: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Segmentasi pasar adalah membelah pasar yang beragam menjadi kelompok-kelompok yang di dalamnya kebutuhannya mirip — ini langkah **S** sebelum targeting dan positioning.
segments.tr: 1. Market segmentation is splitting a diverse market into groups with similar needs — this is the **S** step before targeting and positioning.

segments.src: 2. Empat pisau pembelah yang umum: **geografis, demografis, psikografis, dan perilaku**; variabel perilaku sering paling tajam karena berbasis tindakan nyata, bukan asumsi.
segments.tr: 2. Four common splitting knives: **geographic, demographic, psychographic, and behavioral**; behavioral variables are often the sharpest because they are based on real actions, not assumptions.

segments.src: 3. Segmen baru layak dikejar bila **terukur, cukup besar, dapat dijangkau, dapat dibedakan, dan dapat ditindaklanjuti** — pembelahan yang tidak mengubah keputusan bisnis hanyalah hiasan.
segments.tr: 3. A segment is only worth pursuing if it is **measurable, substantial, accessible, differentiable, and actionable** — a split that doesn't change business decisions is just decoration.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** "Pelanggan yang hanya berbelanja saat promo tanggal kembar 11.11" adalah contoh segmentasi berdasarkan variabel apa?
segments.tr: **1.** "Customers who only shop during the 11.11 double-date promo" is an example of segmentation based on what variable?

segments.src: a) Geografis
segments.tr: a) Geographic

segments.src: b) Demografis
segments.tr: b) Demographic

segments.src: c) Psikografis
segments.tr: c) Psychographic

segments.src: d) Perilaku
segments.tr: d) Behavioral

segments.src: **2.** (O/X) Karena data demografis paling mudah diperoleh dan diukur, segmentasi demografis selalu cukup dan variabel lain tidak diperlukan.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) Because demographic data is the easiest to obtain and measure, demographic segmentation is always sufficient and other variables are not needed.

segments.src: **3.** Sebuah startup menetapkan segmen "orang Indonesia yang ingin hidup lebih bahagia".
segments.tr: **3.** A startup defines a segment of "Indonesian people who want to live happier lives".

segments.src: Kelemahan utama segmen ini dilihat dari syarat segmen yang efektif adalah:
segments.tr: The main weakness of this segment viewed from the criteria of an effective segment is:

segments.src: a) Segmennya terlalu kecil sehingga tidak menguntungkan
segments.tr: a) The segment is too small to be profitable

segments.src: b) Segmennya tidak terukur dan tidak dapat ditindaklanjuti secara konkret
segments.tr: b) The segment is not measurable and cannot be acted upon concretely

segments.src: c) Segmennya tidak boleh berbasis emosi
segments.tr: c) The segment cannot be based on emotions

segments.src: d) Segmennya melanggar prinsip positioning
segments.tr: d) The segment violates the principles of positioning

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Terms of the Day

segments.src: - **Segmentasi Pasar (Market Segmentation):** proses membagi pasar yang heterogen menjadi kelompok-kelompok pembeli yang relatif seragam kebutuhan atau responsnya.
segments.tr: - **Market Segmentation:** the process of dividing a heterogeneous market into groups of buyers that are relatively uniform in their needs or responses.

segments.src: - **STP:** kerangka kerja Segmentation → Targeting → Positioning; segmentasi membelah pasar, targeting memilih segmen, positioning menentukan posisi di benak pelanggan.
segments.tr: - **STP:** the Segmentation → Targeting → Positioning framework; segmentation splits the market, targeting selects the segment, positioning determines the position in the customer's mind.

segments.src: - **Variabel Psikografis:** dasar segmentasi berbasis gaya hidup, nilai, dan kepribadian, sering diringkas sebagai AIO (kegiatan, minat, pendapat).
segments.tr: - **Psychographic Variable:** a basis for segmentation based on lifestyle, values, and personality, often summarized as AIO (activities, interests, opinions).

segments.src: - **Benefit Sought:** manfaat spesifik yang dicari pembeli dari sebuah produk; dua orang bisa membeli barang yang sama untuk alasan yang sama sekali berbeda.
segments.tr: - **Benefit Sought:** the specific benefit a buyer seeks from a product; two people can buy the same item for completely different reasons.

segments.src: - **Heavy User:** kelompok pelanggan dengan frekuensi atau volume pemakaian tinggi, yang porsi kontribusinya terhadap penjualan biasanya jauh melebihi porsi jumlahnya.
segments.tr: - **Heavy User:** a customer group with high frequency or volume of usage, whose contribution portion to sales usually far exceeds their portion of the total count.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) d — waktu dan pemicu pembelian termasuk variabel perilaku (occasion), bukan identitas pembeli.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) d — time and purchase triggers are behavioral variables (occasion), not buyer identity.

segments.src: 2) X (Salah) — demografi mudah diukur tapi tidak menjelaskan alasan membeli; dua orang dengan profil identik bisa berperilaku sangat berbeda, sehingga variabel psikografis dan perilaku tetap dibutuhkan.
segments.tr: 2) F (False) — demographics are easy to measure but do not explain the reason for buying; two people with identical profiles can behave very differently, so psychographic and behavioral variables are still needed.

segments.src: 3) b — segmen tersebut tidak bisa diperkirakan ukurannya, tidak jelas cara menjangkaunya, dan tidak memberi arahan konkret untuk keputusan produk, harga, atau saluran.*
segments.tr: 3) b — the segment cannot have its size estimated, it is unclear how to reach it, and it provides no concrete direction for product, price, or channel decisions.*

id-20260908-news-2.title: September 2026 CPO Reference Price Rises to US$1,007.51 per Ton, Export Duty and Palm Oil Levy Also Pulled Up

segments.src: Kementerian Perdagangan (Kemendag) menetapkan kenaikan harga referensi crude palm oil (CPO) untuk periode September 2026 menjadi US$1.007,51 per metrik ton.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Trade (Kemendag) has set an increase in the reference price for crude palm oil (CPO) for the September 2026 period to US$1,007.51 per metric ton.

segments.src: Penyesuaian ini secara otomatis mendorong naiknya besaran bea keluar (BK) dan pungutan ekspor (PE) untuk komoditas kelapa sawit serta produk turunannya, mengikuti mekanisme perhitungan berjenjang yang selama ini berlaku.
segments.tr: This adjustment automatically drives up the amount of export duty (BK) and export levy (PE) for palm oil commodities and their derivative products, following the tiered calculation mechanism that has been in effect.

segments.src: ## Mekanisme Penetapan Harga Referensi
segments.tr: ## Reference Price Determination Mechanism

segments.src: Harga referensi CPO ditetapkan secara berkala oleh Kemendag berdasarkan rata-rata harga yang terbentuk di sejumlah bursa acuan, termasuk Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange (Bursa Malaysia) dan Rotterdam.
segments.tr: The CPO reference price is determined periodically by the Ministry of Trade based on the average prices formed on a number of reference exchanges, including the Bursa Malaysia Derivatives Exchange (Bursa Malaysia) and Rotterdam.

segments.src: Angka ini menjadi dasar perhitungan tarif bea keluar progresif serta pungutan ekspor sawit yang dikelola oleh Badan Pengelola Dana Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit (BPDPKS).
segments.tr: This figure serves as the basis for calculating progressive export duty tariffs as well as palm oil export levies managed by the Oil Palm Plantation Fund Management Agency (BPDPKS).

segments.src: Semakin tinggi harga referensi menembus ambang batas tertentu, semakin besar pula tarif yang dikenakan per lapisan (bracket) harga.
segments.tr: The higher the reference price breaks through certain thresholds, the greater the tariff charged per price bracket.

segments.src: Dengan harga referensi tembus level US$1.007,51 per ton pada September 2026, sejumlah lapisan tarif otomatis naik dibandingkan bulan sebelumnya, sehingga total pungutan yang harus dibayar eksportir untuk setiap ton CPO dan turunannya turut meningkat.
segments.tr: With the reference price breaking the level of US$1,007.51 per ton in September 2026, a number of tariff brackets automatically rise compared to the previous month, so that the total levy that exporters must pay for every ton of CPO and its derivatives also increases.

segments.src: ## Dampak ke Pelaku Usaha dan Petani
segments.tr: ## Impact on Business Actors and Farmers

segments.src: Kenaikan bea keluar dan pungutan ekspor ini berpotensi menambah beban biaya bagi eksportir CPO, meskipun di sisi lain kenaikan harga referensi juga mencerminkan penguatan harga jual di pasar global.
segments.tr: This increase in export duty and export levy has the potential to add cost burdens for CPO exporters, although on the other hand the rise in the reference price also reflects the strengthening of selling prices in the global market.

segments.src: Pelaku industri biasanya akan mencermati dua sisi ini secara bersamaan: harga jual yang lebih baik di satu sisi, namun pungutan yang lebih tinggi di sisi lain.
segments.tr: Industry players will usually observe these two sides simultaneously: better selling prices on the one hand, but higher levies on the other.

segments.src: Bagi petani sawit swadaya, pergerakan harga referensi ini turut menjadi acuan tidak langsung dalam pembentukan harga tandan buah segar (TBS) di tingkat daerah, karena sejumlah pemerintah provinsi menggunakan komponen harga CPO internasional sebagai salah satu variabel dalam rumus penetapan harga TBS.
segments.tr: For independent smallholder palm oil farmers, this movement in the reference price also serves as an indirect reference in the formation of fresh fruit bunch (TBS) prices at the regional level, because a number of provincial governments use international CPO price components as one of the variables in the TBS pricing formula.

segments.src: ## Bayang-Bayang Kebijakan Tarif Dagang AS
segments.tr: ## The Shadow of US Trade Tariff Policies

segments.src: Kenaikan pungutan ekspor ini terjadi di tengah dinamika kebijakan tarif dagang yang diterapkan Amerika Serikat terhadap sejumlah komoditas asal Indonesia.
segments.tr: This increase in the export levy occurs amidst the dynamics of trade tariff policies applied by the United States against a number of commodities originating from Indonesia.

segments.src: Pelaku usaha dan asosiasi industri sawit di dalam negeri disebut terus mencermati perkembangan kebijakan tarif tersebut, mengingat AS merupakan salah satu tujuan ekspor produk berbasis kelapa sawit dan turunannya, termasuk oleokimia.
segments.tr: Business actors and domestic palm oil industry associations are said to continue observing the developments of these tariff policies, given that the US is one of the export destinations for palm oil-based products and their derivatives, including oleochemicals.

segments.src: Kombinasi antara kenaikan pungutan ekspor domestik dan potensi tekanan tarif dari pasar tujuan ekspor dinilai perlu menjadi perhatian bersama antara pemerintah dan pelaku industri, agar daya saing produk sawit Indonesia di pasar global tetap terjaga.
segments.tr: The combination of the domestic export levy increase and potential tariff pressures from export destination markets is considered to require shared attention between the government and industry players, so that the competitiveness of Indonesian palm oil products in the global market is maintained.

segments.src: ## Penggunaan Dana Pungutan Ekspor
segments.tr: ## Use of Export Levy Funds

segments.src: Dana yang terkumpul dari pungutan ekspor sawit melalui BPDPKS selama ini dialokasikan untuk sejumlah program strategis, di antaranya:
segments.tr: Funds collected from palm oil export levies through BPDPKS have so far been allocated for a number of strategic programs, including:

segments.src: - Subsidi campuran biodiesel (program mandatori B-series) untuk mendukung ketahanan energi nasional
segments.tr: - Biodiesel blending subsidy (B-series mandatory program) to support national energy security

segments.src: - Peremajaan sawit rakyat (replanting) bagi petani swadaya
segments.tr: - Smallholder palm oil rejuvenation (replanting) for independent farmers

segments.src: - Program riset dan pengembangan produktivitas kelapa sawit
segments.tr: - Palm oil productivity research and development programs

segments.src: - Promosi dan advokasi produk sawit Indonesia di pasar internasional
segments.tr: - Promotion and advocacy of Indonesian palm oil products in the international market

segments.src: Dengan naiknya harga referensi dan pungutan ekspor, potensi penerimaan dana sawit pada September 2026 diperkirakan turut mengalami peningkatan, yang pada gilirannya dapat memperkuat kapasitas pembiayaan program-program tersebut.
segments.tr: With the rise in the reference price and export levy, the potential for palm oil fund revenue in September 2026 is also estimated to experience an increase, which in turn can strengthen the financing capacity for these programs.

segments.src: ## Yang Perlu Dicermati ke Depan
segments.tr: ## What to Watch Ahead

segments.src: Pergerakan harga CPO di pasar global masih dipengaruhi sejumlah faktor, mulai dari tingkat produksi minyak nabati dunia, permintaan dari negara-negara importir utama seperti India dan Tiongkok, hingga kebijakan energi terbarukan di berbagai negara yang memengaruhi permintaan bahan baku biodiesel.
segments.tr: The movement of CPO prices in the global market is still influenced by a number of factors, ranging from the level of world vegetable oil production, demand from major importing countries such as India and China, to renewable energy policies in various countries that affect the demand for biodiesel raw materials.

segments.src: Pelaku pasar disarankan untuk terus memantau pengumuman resmi Kemendag setiap awal bulan terkait penetapan harga referensi, bea keluar, dan pungutan ekspor CPO, mengingat angka ini bersifat dinamis dan dapat berubah signifikan sesuai pergerakan harga di bursa acuan internasional.
segments.tr: Market participants are advised to continue monitoring the Ministry of Trade's official announcements at the beginning of each month regarding the determination of reference prices, export duties, and CPO export levies, given that these figures are dynamic and can change significantly according to price movements on international reference exchanges.
